---
name: Skill proposal
about: Propose a new skill or a change to an existing one
labels: skill
---

## Problem

What task does the agent do badly or inconsistently today?

## Proposed skill

Name and one-sentence description (keep it short; every listed description costs context in every session).

## Visibility

Should it appear in the automatic skill listing, or be hidden and invoked explicitly?

## Sources

Is any content adapted from another project? Give the source and its license.

## Evidence

An example session, failure, or evaluation showing the gap.
